newsitem.title: USA: Lee to buy Pacific Northwest Publishing.
newsitem.headline: Lee to buy Pacific Northwest Publishing.

text.p: Lee Enterprises Inc said Monday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire the Pacific Northwest Publishing Group from ABC Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Walt Disney Co.
The Pacific Northwest Publishing Group publishes daily and weekly newspapers, shoppers and specialty publications. Lee said the purchase price is about $185 million.

The shopper and specialty publication group covers eight markets in the states of Washington, Oregon, Nevada and Utah. They are grouped into three geographic regions with total circulation of 980,000 and estimated readership of more than 2.2 million, Lee said.

The newspaper group publishes eight Oregon newspapers geographically clustered in the Willamette Valley. The two daily and six weekly newspapers have an aggregate paid circulation of approximately 67,000.

"One of our principal strategies is to acquire print and broadcast properties that are in growth markets and have regional opportunities to better serve our customers," Richard Gottlieb, president, said in a statement. "With our presence already in the Northwest with KOIN-TV in Portland, Oregon, and the Corvallis Gazette-Times in Corvallis, Oregon, we see exciting opportunities to provide new product platforms for our customers."
Lee owns and operates nine full-service network affiliated television stations, seven satellite television stations and publishes 19 daily newspapers and 36 weekly and specialty publications.
